packageRules.description: VanillaBP, the Business Cockpit and the BPMS adapters follow the framework, not Renovate: their versions are bumped when a release is cut, and while they are snapshots there is nothing to look up.
No Operaton version is pinned here, it comes with the Operaton adapter. Camunda is only in the test which runs next to Camunda 7, through the Camunda 7 adapter.
